summary: Nova Ltd., an Israeli foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing record second-quarter 2026 financial results. The release details quarterly revenue of $255.0 million, GAAP net income of $75.0 million ($2.20 per diluted share), and non-GAAP net income of $86.5 million ($2.51 per diluted share), along with a Q3 2026 outlook. This is a routine earnings disclosure, not a special-situation transaction. No M&A, tender, restructuring, or other corporate event is present. The filing is purely informational and incorporates GAAP tables into existing Form S-8 registration statements. Investors should monitor upcoming quarterly results and guidance for operational trends.
